summary: CRT-style string helper: reads the int pointed to by a2, formats it into a local buffer with the '%d' format string (literal at 0x005C3280) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then appends the formatted digits to the destination string a1 with strcat. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Read the value to format: v3 = *a2.
Initialize the local buffer as an empty string: v4[0] = 0.
Format the value into the buffer: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "%d", v3); the format literal aD_1 lives at global 0x005C3280.
Append the formatted digits to the destination: strcat(a1, v4).
Invoked by DebugLogFormat (0x004B1B10) to append an integer argument to a log message.
